response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx <> 0 THEN (s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx END) AS avg_rel_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM g WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.fundflux, g.avg_rel_diff, g.ratio, g.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS ratio_above_avg FROM g, a WHERE g.ratio > a.avg_ratio
